# Pitch physical chain

A pitch act precedes a pitch-ball-motion process involving a pitch-scoped baseball and governed by the pitch rule.

This view shows the ontology pattern without MLB JSON paths or RML machinery.

flowchart LR
    N01["Pitch Rule"]
    N02["Baseball"]
    N03["Pitch Act"]
    N04["one-dimensional temporal region"]
    N05["Plate Appearance"]

    N08["Pitcher"]
    N09["Baseball Field"]
    N03 -->|has participant| N02

    N03 -->|occurrent part of| N05
